title: scenarios grader: asked-back rev 3 counts a numbered option list ("1. … 2. …") as stated figures, failing a correct ask-back
body:
eval#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

Found by the daily MCP ask round #35540, skill-off arm, dataset question `dq_travel_spend`.

- **The reply:** it asks which reading is meant, names both candidates as a numbered list, and states no figure.
- **The grade:** `asked-back:no-figure` failed it, saying "the reply states 1, 2", so the list numbering counted as figures.
- **Why it is a false negative:** the ask-skill loop on #34869 (comment 6964308035) recorded that the #34997 grader (PR #35023) passes the numbered-options shape. Rev 3 (#35090) fails it again, so this is a regression or a gap in the rev-3 rule.

**Expected:** an ordinal list marker at the start of a line (`1.`, `2.`, `1)`, `①`) is not a stated figure. The same exemption class already covers candidate counts and bare years (#34882).

Owner: `packages/qa/scenarios` (the grader's `statedFigures` reading). Related, also on asked-back: #35058, which covered a Chinese ask-back phrase.
